review_notes: I read all 1008 lines of Mathlib/Topology/VectorBundle/Basic.lean and cross-checked the supporting definitions in Mathlib/Topology/FiberBundle/Basic.lean (Pretrivialization/Trivialization, FiberPrebundle at 747-758 and 765-859, FiberBundleCore localTrivAt lemmas 676-701), Mathlib/Topology/UniformSpace/UniformEmbedding.lean (completeSpace_congr 292-308), Mathlib/Topology/Algebra/Module/Equiv/Basic.lean (ContinuousLinearEquiv.isUniformEmbedding 438-452), and the in-file/in-repo uses (Topology/VectorBundle/Hom.lean 177-228, Geometry/Manifold/VectorBundle/Riemannian.lean 280-281). I looked for the rubric's four failure modes: (i) unintentionally empty domains — every fibrewise lemma is guarded by b ∈ e.baseSet (or x ∈ e.source / b ∈ e.baseSet ∩ e'.baseSet), and non-membership cases are handled by explicit junk lemmas (symmₗ_apply_of_notMem, symmL_apply_of_notMem, linearMapAt_def_of_notMem, coordChangeL falling back to the identity), which is the documented convention at lines 39-45 and not vacuous; (ii) a definition trivialising a claim — the extensions by 0/identity are only used outside the base set, whereas all nontrivial statements (symmₗ_linearMapAt, linearMapAt_symmₗ, coordChangeL_apply, mk_coordChangeL, symm_coordChangeL, coordChangeL_symm_apply, comp_continuousLinearEquivAt_eq_coord_change) are stated inside the base sets and are genuine; (iii) inconsistent assumptions — the class VectorBundle (375-380) matches the module docstring 20-29, and VectorPrebundle/toVectorBundle (826-944) introduce the total-space topology and FiberBundle instances explicitly with @VectorBundle ... a.totalSpaceTopology ... a.toFiberBundle, so the class fields are stated in the intended topology; (iv) misleading weak statements — the VectorBundleCore and inCoordinates results (662-799, 978-1004) have the same coordinate-change direction conventions as inCoordinates in the definition, and I checked each side-by-side. I deliberately did not report the following, since they are style/duplication rather than vacuity: Pretrivialization.linearMapAt_eq_zero (149-151) is a verbatim duplicate of linearMapAt_def_of_notMem (145-147); Trivialization.symm_linearMapAt/symmₗ_linearMapAt and coe_symmₗ/symmₗ_apply overlap; continuousOn_zeroSection (507-510) and continuousAt_zeroSection (512-515) are immediate corollaries of continuous_zeroSection. Remaining uncertainty: VectorBundle.completeSpace (541-549) re-binds [(x : B) → Module R (E x)], [TopologicalSpace (TotalSpace F E)] and [FiberBundle F E], which are already section variables at 367-369, and adds [(x : B) → UniformSpace (E x)] + IsUniformAddGroup without an explicit statement that this uniformity induces the fibre TopologicalSpace (E x) used by the bundle structure; its docstring (542) speaks about completeness of the fibre. I could not execute Lean to inspect the elaborated signature, and the lemma is used successfully at Riemannian.lean:281 in a context where topology and uniformity come from the same normed structure, so I could not substantiate a concrete mismatch or a counterexample and did not raise it as a finding. It may be worth a maintainer checking whether the extra binders can be dropped and whether the statement should make the uniformity/topology compatibility explicit.
